verdict.rationale: Adyen In-Person Payments is a payments platform (Terminal API, terminals, Tap to Pay), not an AI agent or LLM host. Acting as an MCP client that consumes tools from MCP servers is a category error for this kind of product. The documented Adyen MCP server is a server-side capability: it lets external LLM clients call Adyen, so it does not make this client axis applicable.
